title: Lesson summary
description: The structure a model must return for one session. Baton renders this; the model never writes the final document. Free prose drifts in ways a small local model cannot be told out of, so the shape is enforced rather than requested.

overview.description: One to three sentences on how the session went overall. Compare with the previous session where there is something real to compare.

progress.description: What changed since the previous session, each entry as the state before and the state now. This is the section a family reads to learn whether the lessons are working, and the one a rating cannot carry: "doing very well" is a verdict, "needed counting aloud with them" to "counts through the piece unaided" is evidence. Required whenever there is a previous session to compare against.

before.description: How it stood before, taken from the previous session rather than guessed.

after.description: How it stands now, observed in this session.

covered.description: What was actually worked on. One entry per topic, technique, or passage.

notation.description: Tab, chord chart, or rhythm notation, rendered as a code block so it keeps its alignment.

focus.description: Difficulties, each paired with what to do about it. An issue with no fix is an observation, not teaching, so `fix` is required whenever an entry exists.

goals.description: What to practise before the next session. Written as instructions someone can act on without the teacher present.

callouts.description: References into the studio's own theory notes, by id. Baton substitutes the stored text. A model cannot invent theory content here: an id that does not exist is rejected.

extra_sections.description: Typed escape hatch for a studio whose lessons do not fit the fixed sections. Still structured, so it still renders deterministically.

short_summary.description: The message a parent receives. Constraints here are validated, not merely requested: emoji, links, and length are checked by code because a prose instruction not to use them is exactly what a small model ignores.

teacher_followup.description: For the teacher only, never shown to a family: what to watch for or develop next lesson, drawn from this lesson's notes. A suggestion, not an instruction.
